Library

Prometheus2Heraclitus · From Prometheus to Heraclitus

A Skill collection for bringing generative capacities into a finite life.

Begin from this example, write your own philosophy, distill your private models, and make the thought you choose to share into your own works and website. Philosophical writing helps explore an initially unclear self-understanding. Clear, grounded relations are distilled into five core accounts for actual model collaboration: orientation, person, counterpart, relationship, and environment. They state adopted philosophy and direction, understand the participants and their joint activity, and explain realization. Concrete identity, episodes, and original material remain with private sources. Public work can express philosophy and selected understanding while the person retains the complete personal model privately. The collection offers this practice of creation and modeling, beyond replacing a ready-made configuration.

This collection centers modeling, rather than providing a memory system. Its Yinyang package begins with a particular person: philosophical, psychological, and preference material grounds a dynamic user model. Its current psychological modeling from event history distills long-term conversation history and everyday life with philosophy into a natural-language conceptual account, from which a corresponding agent model and relationship are formed. Their work enters the world, and its consequences revise understanding. Memory retains material and continuity; modeling organizes meaning, relationships, and change so that understanding participates in judgment and action.

Philosophy is a whole that can continue to be written. Literature, history, aesthetics, computing, and engineering can all supply modeling material. Different views can be retained, compared, or combined without first joining one school. Accommodating conflict still distinguishes retained material, currently adopted understanding, and its consequences. Specialist methods and tools give the understanding usable forms; another person may develop an entirely different philosophy and environment.

These are usable examples, including the Skills themselves. Take, combine, or reauthor what helps you make your own work; a new philosophy may look quite unlike Yinyang. The shared ambition is creative capacity, not agreement with one doctrine. An example and a commons develops this invitation and distinguishes literary form from technical format. The Documents & diagrams page presents the maintained documents and diagrams alongside their source links.

Philosophy, psychology, and engineering: develop the missing connection

Philosophy articulates understanding and direction, psychology understands the particular person, and engineering realizes the relationship in a usable environment. These contributions support one another. Enter through available material and practice and develop the missing contribution; the person need not first complete three academic disciplines independently.

If a usable engineering environment is missing, develop it with the model. Files, retrieval, tools, execution, and verification make formation and continued use possible; the person need not first master engineering. The maintained starting conditions distinguish actual philosophical writing, psychological or life material, and working environments, singly and in pairs. They identify the next contribution without making formation closed stages. Installed configurations can reflect constraints, habits, or defaults, so tool inventory alone cannot establish the person. Philosophy, grounded accounts, and environment continue to revise one another. Yinyang's package guide explains its six working files and use: five grounded accounts and the revision guide.

Yinyang supplies culture, thought, and reasoning forms; personal substance comes from authorized actual material and the consuming model's collaboration with the person. Its essays and diagrams belong inside skills/yinyang/references/. They are accessories of that Skill. Other members retain their own purposes and specialist methods; collection membership does not make them Yinyang references or impose its philosophy on their use. In a combined practice, Yinyang is an example of a user's philosophy, while other Skills supplement it with concrete abilities. Readers can choose their own combination and write a different philosophy around it.

The public packages preserve the shape and useful companion relationships of the working local methods. Read each package’s dependency and configuration guidance, download the companions needed for the selected task, and bind your own tools and environment. A companion Skill supplies a method, not automatic authentication, device access, or a running service. Private participant accounts, credentials, personal records, and host-specific bindings are excluded.

Maintenance and contributions

Read Contributing for choosing an Issue or PR, preparing a change, and understanding review and publication.

MODEL.md owns collection maintenance and publication boundaries; AGENTS.md orients contributors. Each Skill owns any further interpretation and maintenance instructions in its directory. English is primary; reader editions retain full semantic parity where provided.

Use issues and pull requests for questions and revisions. Keep personal accounts and private source material with their actual owner. Only authorized reusable material belongs in this collection.

License

Original Yinyang material uses CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, for noncommercial reuse; other reusable packages retain MIT. See the collection scope notice and each package’s LICENSE for applicability, attribution, separate rights, and earlier valid grants.
